fact: ARTICLE 19 reported in February 2026 that the CONAI was still not operational, and that of the bodies it asked for information under the law only Ofnac replied; the Supreme Court declared a request inadmissible on 16 April 2026 for lack of prior CONAI referral.
title: Sénégal-Accès à l'information : la loi votée, peu d'effet
